==Description==
'''Trapper Hermit Crab Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 39 on the regular track. It had a cost of {{BeachBalls|1,410}} or {{Robux|132}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|25,630}} or {{Robux|3,639}}. This item also has had two other costs. First one was the cost before its 20% discount, which had a cost of {{Robux|166}} with a total cost of {{Robux|4,570}}. The second was the price prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, where it had a cost of {{Robux|108}}, with a total cost of {{Robux|3,430}}. 

==Appearance==
'''Trapper Hermit Crab Charm''' appearance is based on the {{Color|Surf|Hermit}} [[Trapper]] skin. The charm has the skin trip, causing it to throw its trap into the air. When used, it will play a sound made when an enemy walks over a {{Color|Surf|Hermit}} [[Trapper]] skin bear trap.

The color changes based on the player's username color, but appears orange in inventory preview.

==Trivia==
*The charm calls the {{Color|Surf|Hermit}} [[Trapper]] the "''Hermit Crab''" skin instead of the "''Hermit''" skin.
**This is most likely because the original skin submission called the skin "''Hermit Crab''".
